does: Puts a fight's turn-order groups in order: merges and splits the groups that share an initiative (esv::MergeSharedInitiativeGroups, esv::SplitSharedInitiativeGroups) and keeps, of two participants, the one eoc::TurnOrderCompare finds earlier in the existing order.

evidence.says: its body in the Toolkit calls esv::MergeSharedInitiativeGroups, the helper at +0x110, esv::SplitSharedInitiativeGroups and eoc::TurnOrderCompare

questions.ask: how two participants of equal initiative and equal Dexterity are first placed (the tie two identical goblins came out of in either order natively): the order the joiners are taken in
